[reviewer-agent] Blocking:
- The added Playwright spec does not validate the behavior changed in [crud.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0083/packages/shared/src/lib/api/crud.ts:15). This patch only trims whitespace inside `scope.organizationIds` before building the scoped filter ([crud.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0083/packages/shared/src/lib/api/crud.ts:15)), and the updated low-level Jest coverage does exercise that path ([crud.test.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0083/packages/shared/src/lib/api/__tests__/crud.test.ts:32)). But the new integration test [TC-UMES-021.spec.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0083/apps/mercato/src/modules/example/__integration__/TC-UMES-021.spec.ts:16) only builds cookies with exact org IDs and checks cross-organization update/delete behavior ([TC-UMES-021.spec.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0083/apps/mercato/src/modules/example/__integration__/TC-UMES-021.spec.ts:156), [TC-UMES-021.spec.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0083/apps/mercato/src/modules/example/__integration__/TC-UMES-021.spec.ts:179), [TC-UMES-021.spec.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0083/apps/mercato/src/modules/example/__integration__/TC-UMES-021.spec.ts:201)). It never supplies whitespace-padded `organizationIds` or otherwise forces the normalization branch, so it would pass before and after this fix. The branch therefore still lacks the required Playwright evidence for the bug it claims to cover.

Scoped verification: `npx jest packages/shared/src/lib/api/__tests__/crud.test.ts --runInBand` passed.
[implementer-agent] Updated: Branch fix/hackon/hck-0083-tests-add-low-level-coverage-for-crud-ts was synchronized by the coordinator.

[reviewer-agent] Blocking:
- The fix in [crud.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0083/packages/shared/src/lib/api/crud.ts:15) is on the wrong side of the failure. In the superadmin tenant-override path, the padded org cookie is preserved as `selectedId` in [organizationScope.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0083/packages/core/src/modules/directory/utils/organizationScope.ts:103), then converted to `organizationIds = []` in [factory.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0083/packages/shared/src/lib/crud/factory.ts:1087), and update/delete still call `buildScopedWhere` with that empty array in [factory.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0083/packages/shared/src/lib/crud/factory.ts:2240) and [factory.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0083/packages/shared/src/lib/crud/factory.ts:2542). I reproduced this with a scoped Node script against the compiled helpers: padded selected org => `filterIds: []` and `where.organizationId = { $in: [] }`. So the branch does not actually repair the `TC-UMES-021` scenario.
- The new low-level coverage in [crud.test.ts](/home/hacker/repo/open-mercato/.workspace/worktrees/open-mercato/HCK-0083/packages/shared/src/lib/api/__tests__/crud.test.ts:32) only checks trimming when `organizationIds` already contains padded values. It never exercises the real request path where the padded cookie is turned into an empty scoped filter set upstream, so the added unit test can pass while the regression remains.

`yarn workspace @open-mercato/shared test src/lib/api/__tests__/crud.test.ts --runInBand` passes. I did not run the full Playwright suite.
